source_title: Ведомости Съезда народных депутатов СССР и Верховного Совета СССР, 1991, No. 35 (28 August 1991), scanned issue, Internet Archive capture 20211204065955; recorded for the Presidency

live_file_response.note: The live static file on the non-official SSSR.SU host, byte-identical to the recorded capture; requested without Accept-Encoding and served without Content-Encoding.

stability_check: This packet: downloaded at 2026-10-01T12:03:15Z and again at 2026-10-01T12:37:06Z (33 minutes later) with plain curl 8.16.0 (curl's own User-Agent, no Accept-Encoding header, no cookies, no cache-busting query, no redirect followed); identical 618,372 bytes and SHA-256; the attached response also matched on both downloads. The base32 SHA-1 of the recorded bytes equals the Internet Archive CDX digest XBOY76DZ7UUFTRYS3MXBR444NT5FPJMC.
provenance_note: Raw Internet Archive capture (id_ form) of https://vedomosti.sssr.su/1991/35.pdf, captured at 2021-12-04T06:59:55Z, before the 7 September 2026 cutoff; requested without an Accept-Encoding header (curl without --compressed) and served without Content-Encoding, so the recorded identity is the uncompressed body as replayed. The same bytes are served as a static file by the live host (live_file_response); the capture is recorded as the identity because it is fixed before the cutoff. The original response is not checked into this repository; this checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not the original response. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Attributed factual paraphrases only; no source artwork or portrait copied, and no photograph, emblem, signature image or expressive source text is republished. No open license is asserted. No portrait permission or likeness approval is established.
scope_note: The same bytes as su_ved_1991_35 (CLAUDE-C01-26) and su_ved_1991_35_cpsu (CLAUDE-C01-41), recorded under a new ID so that their extracts stay unchanged. Imported: points 1 and 2 of the Presidium's resolution 2352-I of 21 August 1991 (art. 1001) and the signature and date block of decree УП-2443 of 22 August 1991 (art. 1008), for the President's role.

edition_and_host.edition: Ведомости, 1991, № 35; art. 1001 on printed p. 1420 (PDF p. 14); art. 1008 on printed p. 1423 (PDF p. 17).
edition_and_host.host: SSSR.SU portal (snd.sssr.su, vedomosti.sssr.su, izvestija.sssr.su): a non-commercial project registered as the media outlet 'Информационное агентство «СССР»' (Roskomnadzor ИА № ФС77-40345), not a state body and not the publisher; it serves page-image scans of the official publications as static files (see the CLAUDE-C01-SOURCE-26 review of the same host).

visual_review.method: Every cited passage was rendered from the recorded bytes with PyMuPDF (100-260 dpi crops) and read from the page image; the PDF's text layer (OCR), where present, was used only to find passages. Headings, signature and date blocks, mastheads and quotations were compared with the image.

rows.role_title: Президент СССР — President of the USSR
rows.text: Resolution of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of the USSR 'О неотложных мерах по восстановлению конституционного порядка в стране' (art. 1001), point 1: 'Считать незаконным фактическое отстранение Президента СССР М. С. Горбачева от исполнения его конституционных обязанностей и передачу их Вице-президенту.' Signed 'Председатель Верховного Совета СССР А. ЛУКЬЯНОВ'; 'Москва, Кремль 21 августа 1991 г. № 2352—I'.
rows.locator: Art. 1001, point 1 and signature and date block, printed p. 1420 (PDF p. 14)

rows.role_title: Президент СССР — President of the USSR
rows.text: Point 2 of the same resolution: 'Потребовать от Вице-президента Г. И. Янаева немедленной отмены его указов и основанных на них постановлений о чрезвычайном положении как юридически недействительных с момента их подписания.'

rows.role_title: Президент СССР — President of the USSR
rows.text: Decree 'Об освобождении Павлова В. С. от обязанностей Премьер-министра СССР' (art. 1008) is signed 'Президент Союза Советских Социалистических Республик М. ГОРБАЧЕВ' and dated 'Москва, Кремль. 22 августа 1991 г. № УП—2443.'
rows.locator: Art. 1008, signature and date block, printed p. 1423 (PDF p. 17)

bounded_scope: USSR President and head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-49 only. Ballot, election result, election resolution, oath, declared assumption of office, appointment approval, stylings, acting-service and transfer-of-powers claims, a legislative body's declaration and in-office signatures stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Party offices, russia.json and the simulation's party rows are outside this extract.
